The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the bottom-logo effect; the deck labels and back-panel styling belong to the control-styling Requirement.
The source concerns colors, controls, labels, lighting, logos, and panel styling, not the spout's appearance, material, or fabrication.

Changing button appearance does not change the solenoid actuation mechanism or press-and-release dispensing behavior.

The visual design instructions do not change any pouring, dripping, flow, texture-preservation, or dispensing-path requirement.
The source changes visual styling only and does not alter splash-control targets or mitigation measures.
